Hi all,

Thanks — attaching a synthetic sample export and an access matrix. Quick notes:

- audit_log_sample.csv (attached): columns = timestamp, principal, role, action, resource, request_id, ip_address, contains_pii, exporter_principal, approval_id
- access_matrix.pdf (attached): maps FincoBank roles to Redwood roles and typical permitted actions

About PII: we have a log field contains_pii which is set by the request pipeline when payload inspection flags sensitive fields (PII) and when downstream storage is encrypted. For additional privacy controls we can:
  - redact payload entries in logs on request
  - provide filtered exports that exclude payloads entirely

Export formats: CSV (preferred), NDJSON, and compressed TAR.GZ for bulk exports. We can provide exports over secure S3 presigned URLs or via direct SFTP to an allowlisted IP.

I’ve attached audit_log_sample.csv (synthetic) and access_matrix.pdf. Also linking the quick export playbook Aditya is drafting — export_playbook.md (will add to Drive by EOD).

Next steps: Sean to confirm retention/configurable windows; Jordan to schedule Thurs 10:00 PT deep-dive; I can join to walk the sample.

Regards,

Subject: Re: Audit logs / data access evidence — retention and exports

Hi Alice/Jordan,

Quick confirmation from the platform/security side:

- Retention windows: platform supports configurable audit log retention at 90/180/365 days per-account. For Dedicated/Private deployments we can extend beyond 365 under contract (we’ll surface pricing/commit).
- Bulk exports: we support on-demand bulk exports in CSV or NDJSON compressed as TAR.GZ. Exports delivered via presigned S3 or SFTP; typical turnaround for a full-year export is 24–48 hours depending on size.
- Chain-of-access: we log exporter_principal and approval_id (if an exported dataset required approval). We can add an approval workflow for exports that surfaces approver identity and timestamp.
- Residency: Hosted logs are stored in the region linked to the customer account (US or EU). For FincoBank we can pin logs to the US region; Dedicated/Private gives you full on-prem control.

I’m attaching a short chain-of-access summary (included in export_playbook.md). If you need a signed attestation for procurement we can provide a statement of controls as part of the SOC2 supplement.

Sean Gallagher
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
